<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 2 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== The Marvelous Land of Oz ==

Old Mombi, known simply as Mombi, is an old woman living in the Country of the Gillikins in the North of the Land of Oz, where she serves as guardian to the boy Tip, raising him since early childhood though he remembers nothing of his parents. Her reputation is poor: the Gillikin people suspect her of practicing magical arts and largely avoid her company. Because the ruling Good Witch has forbidden any other Witch to exist within her dominion, Mombi cannot claim that title outright and is restricted to working as a Sorceress, or at most a Wizardess. She actively pursues magical knowledge, at one point trading secrets with a crooked wizard living in a mountain cave in exchange for three recipes, four magical powders, and a selection of potent herbs, and she keeps a pepper-box containing the Powder of Life among her possessions.

When Tip flees her household after fashioning and animating a pumpkin-headed man named Jack, Mombi discovers the trick and grows furious, both at the deception and at the theft of the Powder of Life. Later, General Jinjur summons her to the Emerald City to help repel the returning Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, and from a tower room she works magic to disorient the travelers, at one point sending a sheet of crackling flame across the meadow toward them. Her history with magic runs deeper still: Glinda later argues that the Wizard of Oz must have taught Mombi many of his tricks in exchange for some earlier assistance, and suspects — though does not confirm — that Mombi helped him conceal the girl Ozma, the rightful heir to the throne of the Emerald City, prompting Glinda to seek Mombi out to force her to reveal where the girl is hidden.

=== Events ===

* Tip, a Gillikin youth whose full name is Tippetarius, lives in the North of Oz under guardian old Mombi, a woman suspected of magical arts.
* Tip remembers nothing of his parents and was raised by Mombi since early childhood.
* Mombi is restricted to being a Sorceress or Wizardess, not a true Witch, by law of the ruling Good Witch.
* Tip does chores for Mombi (wood, corn-fields, pigs, milking) but slacks off and plays whenever her view is blocked.
* Tip openly hates Mombi and shows little respect for her.
* While Mombi is away for two days buying groceries, Tip carves a pumpkin into a jolly face intending to scare her.
* Tip dresses the finished figure in clothes found in Mombi's chest and names him 'Jack Pumpkinhead.'
* Tip carries his pumpkin-headed man Jack to the bend in the road, repairing a fallen-off arm and twisted head along the way, to scare old Mombi.
* Mombi returns home early, having traded secrets with a crooked wizard for three recipes, four magical powders, and herbs of great power.
* Mombi first mistakes Jack for a real man, then recognizes Tip's trick after noticing his carved pumpkin head.
* Deciding to test one of her new powders instead of punishing Tip, Mombi sprinkles the Powder of Life on Jack and speaks magic words over him.
* Jack Pumpkinhead comes to life, delighting Mombi and amazing the hidden, watching Tip.
* Mombi catches Tip laughing, drags him home, and locks Jack in the cow stable for the night.
* At the farmhouse, Mombi brews a potion of milk, vinegar, herbs, and powders, revealing she intends to turn Tip into a marble statue for her garden.
* Tip pleads and bargains against the transformation, but Mombi insists, sets the kettle to cool, and orders him to bed at midnight while she plans to complete the spell at daybreak.
* Tip decides to run away from Mombi rather than be turned into a marble statue.
* Before leaving, he gathers bread and cheese and takes the pepper-box containing the Powder of Life from Mombi's basket.
* He sneaks out at night while Mombi sleeps and heads toward the road.
* Tip recalls and repeats the words and hand gestures he secretly observed old Mombi use, sprinkling the powder on the sawhorse.
* General Jinjur, fearing the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman joining forces against her rebel army, sends for the witch Mombi to stop their return to the Emerald City.
* Mombi uses magic from a tower room to disorient the travelers and prevent their journey.
* The Tin Woodman realizes the group has gone astray and they find themselves surrounded by a field of giant sunflowers with girls' faces, which they suspect is Mombi's illusion.
* Old Mombi conjures a series of illusions—a rushing river, a granite wall, forty whirling roads, and a wall of flame—but the Queen leads the party safely through each false obstacle.
* Jinjur threatens to destroy each companion in a gruesome way, while ordering Tip returned to old Mombi.
* Tip speaks the magic words he learned from Mombi, and the Thing comes to life, screeching and flapping its wings violently.
* Glinda reveals that the true heir to the Emerald City throne is Ozma, daughter of the former King Pastoria, hidden away by the Wizard with old Mombi's help.
* Glinda resolves to march her army on the Emerald City to capture Mombi and force her to reveal where Ozma is hidden.
* Queen Jinjur, alarmed by the army, sends a messenger asking Glinda's demands, and Glinda demands that Mombi be surrendered to her.
* Mombi tricks Jinjur by magically switching appearances with Jellia Jamb, so that Jellia is handed over to Glinda in Mombi's place.
* Glinda questions the disguised Jellia, discovers the deception through magic, and restores Jellia to her true form while Mombi resumes her own shape back in the palace.
* Glinda angrily demands the real Mombi, and Jinjur allows Glinda's search party to enter the city to look for her.
* Mombi evades capture by transforming herself into a red rose growing in the palace garden.
* Mombi, disguised as a rose in the Tin Woodman's button-hole, believes herself safe since no one knows the rose and Mombi are the same.
* Glinda tells the assembled group she has failed to find Mombi and fears the expedition to rescue Ozma will fail.
* The Scarecrow and Tin Woodman each propose alternate plans while Glinda notices the rose trembling and suspects it is Mombi in disguise.
* Discovered, Mombi transforms into a Shadow to flee the tent, but Glinda seals the entrance shut with a wave of her hand.
* Mombi next transforms into a Black Ant to hide, then into a huge Griffin, tearing through the tent wall to escape.
* Glinda throws a golden thread over the exhausted Griffin, destroying the transformation and revealing old Mombi in her true form.
* Glinda captures Mombi using a magical golden thread and brings her back to camp via the Gump.
* Glinda demands Mombi reveal what happened to the infant Ozma, whom the Wizard hid with her years ago.
* Glinda uses a truth-detecting pearl that turns black when Mombi lies, forcing her to confess.
* Mombi admits the Wizard gave her the baby Ozma in exchange for teaching her magic tricks.
* Mombi reveals she transformed the girl Ozma into a boy, and points to Tip as that transformed child.
* Glinda refuses to allow Mombi to reverse the transformation later, calling it dishonest magic, and orders Mombi to restore Tip's true form now.
* Mombi performs the transformation ritual, and Tip emerges as the beautiful Princess Ozma, to the amazement of all.
* Queen Jinjur despairs on learning Mombi confessed and that Tip is truly Princess Ozma.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 4 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz ==

Mombi est une Sorcière malfaisante qui régna autrefois sur le Nord du pays d'Oz, à l'époque où quatre Sorcières se partageaient le royaume. Elle enleva le grand-père d'Ozma, alors souverain, pendant une partie de chasse, et le retint prisonnier, agissant ensuite comme geôlière du père d'Ozma après lui. Elle fut finalement vaincue dans le Nord par une Sorcière bienfaisante. C'est également Mombi qui, à la naissance d'Ozma, la transforma en garçon, espérant ainsi empêcher quiconque de reconnaître en elle la véritable princesse du pays d'Oz.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 5 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== The Road to Oz ==

Mombi is a Witch who obtained the Powder of Life from a crooked Sorcerer living in the mountains of the North Country and brought it home with her. Before Ozma became Princess of Oz, Ozma lived with Mombi, who had transformed her into the shape of a boy. While Mombi was away visiting the crooked Sorcerer, the boy fashioned a pumpkin-headed man, partly to amuse himself and partly hoping to frighten Mombi upon her return. Mombi was not frightened by the creation; instead, she sprinkled the Pumpkinhead with her Magic Powder of Life to see whether it would work.
</div>
